convert_pose_list_to_ros_pose: convert a 6 or 7 element pose list into a ROS geometry_msgs Pose message using list_to_pose
lookup_tf_transform_between_frames: lookup the translation and quaternion transform between two ROS TF frames using get_tf_transform
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a quaternion in x,y,z,w format to a 3x3 rotation matrix using quat_to_rot_mat
convert_euler_angles_to_quaternion: convert yaw, pitch, roll euler angles to a quaternion using euler_to_quat with rzyx axis order
add_box_object_to_moveit_scene: add a box type world object to the Moveit planning scene using MoveitObjectHandler add_world_object
